claims.text: Many reviewers find the Twisted Lime scent foul or offensive, describing it as smelling like garbage, roadkill, or B.O.
Several reviewers report the deodorant does not control odor or last through workouts and hot days.
Some reviewers experienced skin irritation, including a rash, burning, and peeling.
A few reviewers say the product works well and effectively suppresses body odor despite the scent.
Some reviewers note the product is expensive but consider it worth it when it works.

qa.q: Does it actually work for strong body odor?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it works for body odor, including a "very sweaty" user and one who says it works 24+ hours [1][3], while others report it stopped working after a week or did not work at all [4][5].

claims.text: Some reviewers report it works for body odor, including a very sweaty user and one who says it works 24+ hours.
Other reviewers report it stopped working after a week or did not work at all.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is the Twisted Lime scent strong or mild?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the Twisted Lime scent as strong and unpleasant rather than mild, calling it awful and comparing it to lime and B.O., rotten socks, roadkill, and sour sweat [1][3][4][6]. No review describes it as mild.

claims.text: The Twisted Lime scent is described as awful and smelling like lime and B.O. [1].
It is described as stinking badly, like rotten socks [3].
It is described as making the wearer smell like sour sweat [6].
